era: 现代教育时代（1868年浙江绍兴山阴书商之家—少年中秀才举人—1892年殿试二甲进士、点翰林院庶吉士—甲午后弃帖括之学转向新学—1902年与章太炎等创中国教育会、爱国学社—1904年光复会会长、1905年入同盟会—1907年赴德国莱比锡大学研修哲学心理学实验教育学三年余—1912年首任中华民国教育总长（发表《对于教育方针之意见》倡五育并举）—1913年再赴法国办华法教育会与留法勤工俭学—1916年底归国—1917年1月就任北京大学校长：聘陈独秀、胡适、李大钊、鲁迅、梁漱溟，容辜鸿铭、刘师培于一校；废门改系、选科制、教授治校、评议会、进德会—1919年五四运动中营救被捕学生后辞职出走—1927年后任大学院院长、中央研究院首任院长—1929年后专任中研院—1932年与宋庆龄、鲁迅等发起中国民权保障同盟—1940年3月5日病逝于香港：绍兴—翰林—莱比锡—北大—中研院—香港）
school: 现代中国大学理念奠基人（'思想自由、兼容并包'）+ 五育并举教育方针提出者 + 美育代宗教论创立者 + 北京大学现代化改革主持者 + 教授治校制度设计者 + 中央研究院创建者（'学界泰斗，人世楷模'）
style_name: Cai Yuanpei / Tsai Yuan-pei（威妥玛拼法）；字鹤卿，号孑民
courtesy_name: 字鹤卿（取'鹤鸣于九皋，卿云烂兮'之意，一说从'鹤卿'乳名）；1912年后自号'孑民'（'周余黎民，靡有孑遗'之意，自谦乱世孑遗之民）
pseudonym: 笔名'孑民'、'蔡振'（爱国学社时期以'蔡振'署名发表《释仇满》）、'鹤廮'；论学文字多署本名或孑民；'囊括大典，网罗众家，思想自由，兼容并包'为其北大改革纲领名句
historical_significance: 蔡元培（1868-1940），浙江绍兴人，中国现代大学制度的总设计师。他是前清翰林出身而倒向革命的第一代学者：甲午后自费购读新学书报，四十岁留德入莱比锡大学听哲学、心理学、实验教育学——把'科举功名'兑换成'现代学术'的第一人。1912年任民国首任教育总长，发表《对于新教育之意见》，提出军国民、实利、公民道德、世界观、美育五育并举，废弃钦定教育宗旨中'忠君尊孔'两纲；主持制定壬子癸丑学制。1917年就任北京大学校长，以'思想自由、兼容并包'八字改造这所官僚养成所：不问学历党派只问学问——无学位的梁漱溟讲印度哲学、前清遗老辜鸿铭讲英国文学、倡新文化的陈独秀胡适同堂并立；废门改系、实行选科制、设评议会与教授会，'教授治校'由此成为中国大学治理的制度原型；办进德会约束自身，'八不'戒约从校长本人做起。他把美育提到'代宗教'的高度，主张以纯粹情感的陶养替代信仰的强制。1927年后创建大学院（短期学制试验）与中央研究院，为中国建立第一个国家级科学研究体制。1932年与宋庆龄、鲁迅组织中国民权保障同盟，晚年在香港病逝。毛泽东挽'学界泰斗，人世楷模'。他与陶行知、晏阳初同处'教育走向现代中国'的同一时代工程：陶做学校形态学革命，晏做社会组织学革命，蔡做的是'高等教育与学术体制'的立宪工程——三人互补成现代中国教育的完整版图。
unique_thinking: 蔡元培的独特贡献是为'现代学术共同体'设计了可运行的宪章，并把每一理念都落成可核查的制度条款：其一，本体界定——大学是'研究高深学问之机关'而非升官发财之阶梯，入学第一问是'你来做什么'，把机构的目的从社会身份再生产改写为知识生产；其二，'思想自由、兼容并包'不是折中主义而是竞争性共存——新旧学说'一校之中并存而比较'，让思想在自由竞争中被检验，校长的作用是守边界（学术）而非选边（立场）；其三，多元目的结构——五育并举拒绝把教育目的收束为单一宗旨（无论忠君还是军国民），目的本身必须保持多元与平衡；其四，美育代宗教——以纯粹情感的普遍性（美）替代情感的非普遍装置（宗教），陶养而非信仰；其五，学术权力分立——评议会、教授会、行政会议把立法、教学、行政三权分立进大学，教授治校把'谁有资格决定课程与聘任'的答案从官定改为教员共同体；其六，人才标准重估——'网罗众家'以学术贡献为唯一筹码：无学历者、旧学者、激进者同台，任用依据是'研究之成绩'；其七，团体自律——进德会从校长本人先入会，把道德改革做成公开的、自愿的、可监督的制度而非训诫；其八，勤工俭学——把'留学'从少数人的特权改写为'半工半读'的群众路线，华法教育会为中国输出了整整一代现代人才（周恩来、邓小平等皆经此路）；其九，学术国家建制——中央研究院以'研究'而非'教学'立院，用评议会与院士制度把学术共同体职业化、国际化；其十，道德退出策略——以辞职出走表达原则立场（五四后'杀君马者道旁儿'启事），把'退出'作为知识人最后的否决权，也把机构的独立性置于个人权位之上。

cross_references.relation_type: 同一时代教育工程的两端：蔡立大学宪章，陶改学校存在方式
cross_references.description_zh: 蔡元培与陶行知共享'教育是现代中国的立国工程'这一母题，但工程部位不同：蔡做的是高等教育的立宪工程——大学是什么机构、谁有资格决定课程与聘任、学术权力如何与行政分立；陶做的是基础教育的形态学革命——学校与生活的边界如何拆除。两人在制度工程学上同构：蔡的'兼容并包'与陶的'社会即学校'都是在拆除一道围墙（蔡拆'官方正统'之墙，陶拆'校园围墙'）；蔡的'选科制'与陶的'需要即课程'都把学习者的选择权写进制度。分野在于：蔡始终在体制内改造（翰林—总长—校长—院长），陶最终走向体制外的民间办学。对照链：M-CYP-002（兼容并包竞争共存）× M-TXZ-002（社会即学校）——两堵墙的拆除法；M-CYP-005（教授治校）× M-TXZ-010（民主教育）——'共同体自治'的高教版与普教版。

cross_references.relation_type: 学术金字塔与平民金字塔：教育现代性的两极设计
cross_references.description_zh: 蔡元培的'研究高深学问'与晏阳初的'除文盲、作新民'是同一现代性工程的金字塔两端：蔡认为大学的天职是深度——没有研究高深学问的顶端，一切教育的现代化都无源头活水；晏认为教育天职是广度——四万万文盲不除，顶端学问无处生根。两人的可通约处在于都对'教育为少数特权服务'宣战：蔡的勤工俭学把留学从特权改为半工半读的群众路线，晏的'博士下乡'把知识人从书斋送往田间——两者都是'知识人身份重估'：知识分子的价值不在身份而在用途。分野在于：蔡以国家与大学为建制载体，晏以民间运动为载体。对照链：M-CYP-008（勤工俭学）× M-YC-006（三大方式立体覆盖）——'半工半读'与'学校式社会式家庭式'都是成本重构；M-CYP-007（团体自律进德会）× 晏'博士下乡同住'——知识人自我约束的制度化。

cross_references.relation_type: 庇护者与思想者：兼容并包的受益者与合伙人
cross_references.description_zh: 鲁迅与蔡元培是绍兴同乡、同盟会旧友，蔡任教育总长时延鲁迅入教育部佥事，任北大校长后聘其讲授中国小说史、设计北大校徽——鲁迅的《中国小说史略》正是在'兼容并包'的屋顶下完成的学术作品。蔡的用人逻辑在鲁迅身上体现得最完整：不讲资历，只问'研究之成绩'。分野在于：蔡做制度工程，鲁做国民性批判；蔡以'兼容'守空间，鲁以'批判'用空间——没有蔡守住的屋顶，鲁的杂文少一间屋子；没有鲁们的内容，兼容并包只是空框架。1932年民权保障同盟中两人再度同列，制度庇护者与批判者并肩。对照链：M-CYP-006（人才标准重估）× 鲁迅'拿来主义'——对既有资源的自由取用；M-CYP-010（道德退出）× 鲁迅'横站'——知识人独立姿态的两种语法。

caveats: '兼容并包'在1919年前后更多是策略性庇护（为激进新派挡枪的说辞）还是贯穿始终的信念，学界有争议：他同时不容忍五四中烧毁住宅、殴打师生的暴力，'自由'的边界须按其历次声明还原
北大改革的成效叙述多出自受益者（新派知识分子）的回忆文本，旧派与官方记录中的北大1917-1919（经费拖欠、风潮不断）须并列引用；'改造官僚养成所'的叙事有追认成分
他与国民党的关系（1927年'清党'时期的立场）使其政治评价分裂：'人权同盟'晚节与'清党'参与并存，两岸定性各有阵营叙事，引用须分期处理
中央研究院初期的'学术独立'实际受制于经费与政治环境，'国家科学研究体制的奠基'是从后来追认的长期效果而言，而非当时已然自足运行
美育代宗教论在学理上常被批评为低估了宗教的社群功能与超越维度，且蔡本人的美育实践（音乐会、画法研究会）规模有限，不能支撑'美育运动'的大概括

modes.name_en: Defining the University: An Institution for Higher Learning
modes.definition_zh: 蔡元培改造北大的第一步不是换教师而是改定义：1917年1月就职演说，他把大学从'科举余荫的升官发财阶梯'改写为'研究高深学问之机关'——'大学者，研究高深学问者也。'这不是修辞而是机构本体论的重写：一个机构是什么，取决于进入它的人被要求做什么。方法论签名有三：其一，目的先于结构——先公开宣告机构目的（'诸君须抱定宗旨，为求学而来'），再依目的重排一切结构（招生、课程、聘任、纪律），顺序颠倒则一切改革都是装修；其二，身份脱钩——把'入学'与'做官'的因果链公开切断，'果欲其然，则北京不少若干所学校，尽可入法科……何必来此大学'，用替代路径暴露投机动机；其三，行为审计——以'三问'（来做什么？将来要做什么？现在如何做？）把抽象宗旨变成每次集会可追问的判据。这一模式是后续一切改革（兼容并包、教授治校、选科制）的宪法地基：机构的目的被改写之后，围墙内的权力才有重新分配的正当性。
modes.definition_en: Cai Yuanpei's first act in transforming Peking University was not to change the faculty but to change the definition: in his inaugural address of January 1917 he rewrote the university from 'a ladder to office and fortune with imperial-examination lineage' into 'an institution for the study of profound learning' — 'The university is a place for the study of profound learning.' This is institutional ontology rewritten: what an institution IS depends on what those who enter it are required to DO. Three signatures define the mode. First, purpose precedes structure: publicly declare the institution's aim ('you must hold fast to your purpose, coming here to learn'), THEN rearrange every structure — admissions, curriculum, hiring, discipline — to match; reverse the order and every reform is mere renovation. Second, decoupling status from purpose: openly cut the causal chain between enrollment and officialdom — 'if office is your aim, there are plenty of law and civil-service routes; why come to this university?' — exposing speculative motives by naming the alternative paths. Third, behavioral audit: turn the abstract mission into a recurring question — 'What have you come to do? What will you do afterward? What are you doing now?' — askable at every assembly. The mode is the constitutional base of everything that followed (inclusiveness, faculty governance, the elective system): only after an institution's purpose is rewritten does the redistribution of power inside its walls acquire legitimacy.
modes.source_chapter: 蔡元培《就任北京大学校长之演说》（1917年1月）；《大学令》（1912）；《对于新教育之意见》（1912）
key_concepts: 大学者研究高深学问者也
process_zh: 先改定义：在一切结构调整之前，用一次公开宣告重写机构目的——旧定义不改，任何结构性改革都会被旧目的吞噬
切断错配链：找出机构中被默认的'入口→身份'因果链（如入学即入仕），公开点名并指明替代路径，让投机者自我暴露
设行为审计：把抽象宗旨压成每次集体场合可追问的具体问题（你来做什么？），使宗旨从墙上的字变成会上的问
按新目的重排结构：招生标准、课程设置、聘任条款、纪律条款逐项对照新定义修订——定义先行，结构跟上
process_en: Change the definition first: before touching any structure, publicly rewrite the institution's purpose in one address — if the old definition stands, every structural reform will be swallowed by the old purpose.

Cut the mismatched chain: locate the tacit 'entry-to-status' causal chain inside the institution (enrollment as route to office), name it openly, and point to alternative paths so the speculators expose themselves.

Install a behavioral audit: compress the abstract mission into concrete questions askable at every collective occasion ('what have you come to do?'), turning the mission from words on a wall to a question in the room.
Re-rank structure by the new purpose: revise admissions, curriculum, hiring terms, and discipline item by item against the new definition — definition first, structure follows.
representative_cases_zh: 1917年北大就职演说：面对'预科毕业即谋入法科或入仕'的风气，蔡当众宣布'大学为纯粹研究学问之机关，不可视为养成资格之所'，并把'抱定宗旨'列为对学生的第一要求——先立宪，后改组
北大改革配套：就任后即停发'讲义'式的应试教材崇拜、提高入学门槛、停聘不称职教员——目的是让'来学真本事'的人留下，把'混资格'的人挤走
反面警示：蔡警告的正是他见到的现实——学生'以外籍教员之招引，为将来进身之阶'者众、专心学问者寡；历史反复证明，不先改定义只换楼与楼名（如后来许多'大学'升格运动），机构行为一切照旧：牌子换了，本体未换
representative_cases_en: The 1917 inaugural address: facing a student body that treated the preparatory course as a stepping-stone to law school or office, Cai declared in public that 'the university is an institution purely for the pursuit of learning, not a credential-minting house,' and made 'holding fast to your purpose' the first demand on students — constitution first, reorganization after.

Complementary reforms: upon taking office he curbed the cult of mimeographed exam-prep lecture notes, raised entrance standards, and let unqualified instructors go — so that those who came to learn stayed and those who came to coast were squeezed out.

Cautionary counterexample: what Cai warned against was the reality he saw — many students courted foreign instructors as future patrons rather than studied. History keeps proving that without changing the definition first, renaming and upgrading institutions (as in later 'university-promotion' drives) changes nothing: the plaque is new, the ontology is old.
modern_applications_zh: 机构接任第一演讲：新负责人上任先做'本体宣言'（我们这个团队是做什么的），再动组织结构——顺序反了，团队会用旧行为解释新口号
组织'为什么来'审计：招聘与立项时公开问'你来做什么'，对把平台当跳板者给出替代路径提示，减少错配入职
产品定位重写：把'我们是什么'的旧定义（如'一家卖课的公司'）改写为新本体（'一个研究学习效果的机构'），再按新本体重排KPI
学位与资格脱钩实验：高校把'完成研究/作品'而非'修满学分'设为毕业判据，对冲文凭通胀
modern_applications_en: The first-act declaration: a new leader's first move is an 'ontological address' (what is this team FOR) before any structural change — reverse the order and the team will interpret new slogans with old behavior.
The 'why are you here' audit: at hiring and project kickoff, ask publicly 'what have you come to do'; flag platform-as-springboard motives and name alternatives, cutting mismatched onboarding.
Product-positioning rewrite: change the old definition ('a company selling courses') into a new ontology ('an institution researching how learning works'), then re-rank KPIs against it.
Decoupling degrees from credentials: universities making 'completed research/work' rather than 'credits accrued' the graduation criterion, hedging credential inflation.

modes.domain_zh: 高等教育/学术自由制度设计
modes.domain_en: Higher Education / Institutional Design for Academic Freedom
modes.definition_zh: 蔡元培的'思想自由、兼容并包'常被误读为各打五十大板的折中主义，实则是竞争性共存的制度设计：'大学者，囊括大典、网罗众家之学府也……无论为何种学派，苟其言之成理，持之有故，尚不达自然淘汰之运命者，虽彼此相反，而悉听其自由发展。'方法论签名有三：其一，边界划在'成理有故'——包容的准入条件是学理标准（言之成理、持之有故）而非立场标准，越界的是暴力与专断而非异见；其二，并存即比较——新旧学说'一校之中并存而比较'，自由竞争让思想接受公开检验，校长守的是赛场规则而非比赛结果；其三，守门人不选边——校长对内容保持中立（不因好恶去留教员），对学术边界保持强硬（不因压力庇护不学无术者）。这一模式把'自由'从个人美德转写为机构职责：自由不靠每个人开明，而靠制度对一切'成理之论'的普遍准入。
modes.definition_en: Cai Yuanpei's 'freedom of thought, inclusiveness toward all schools' is often misread as splitting the difference; it is in fact institutional design for competitive coexistence: 'The university embraces the great canon and gathers all schools... whatever the school of thought, if it reasons soundly and holds evidence, and has not yet met natural elimination, then though it contradict its neighbor, it is free to develop.' Three signatures define the mode. First, the boundary is drawn at 'sound reasoning with evidence': the admission criterion for inclusion is a scholarly one (does it reason? does it cite grounds?), not a political one — what is excluded is violence and dogmatism, not dissent. Second, coexistence IS comparison: old and new doctrines 'coexist within one university and are compared'; open competition puts ideas to public test — the president guards the rules of the arena, never the outcome of the match. Third, the gatekeeper takes no side: the president stays neutral on content (no instructor dismissed for the president's likes or dislikes) and hard on the scholarly boundary (no charlatan shielded under pressure). The mode converts 'freedom' from a personal virtue into an institutional duty: freedom rests not on everyone being enlightened but on the institution's universal admission of every well-reasoned claim.
modes.source_chapter: 蔡元培《北京大学月刊》发刊词（1918年11月）；《我在北京大学的经历》；答林琴南函（1919年3月）
process_zh: 先立准入标准：把'包容'的门槛写成学理判据（言之成理、持之有故），而非立场判据——标准先立，包容才不会滑向和稀泥
并行聘任：让相互对立的学派同时进入同一机构（而非分时或分区），制造'并存而比较'的现场——比较需要物理共处
守规则不守结果：公开承诺不因立场去留教员、不因好恶裁断学说，把裁判权交给学理竞争本身
守住硬边界：对诉诸暴力、造假、以势压人者不留情面——包容的对面不是异见而是专断，边界失守则竞争变混战
process_en: Set the admission criterion first: write the threshold of inclusion as a scholarly test (sound reasoning, held evidence), not a political one — set the standard before opening the door, or inclusion dissolves into mush.

Hire in parallel: bring opposing schools into the same institution simultaneously (not staggered or segregated) to create the live 'coexist and compare' arena — comparison requires physical co-presence.
Guard the rules, not the outcome: commit publicly to hiring and firing by scholarly merit alone, never by stance; hand adjudication to open intellectual competition itself.
Hold the hard boundary: show no mercy to violence, fabrication, or coercion — inclusion's opposite is not dissent but dogmatism, and a breached boundary turns competition into brawling.
representative_cases_zh: 北大的屋顶下同堂并立：倡白话文的陈独秀、胡适与前清遗老辜鸿铭（拖着辫子讲英国文学）、刘师培同校授课；无学位的梁漱溟被聘讲印度哲学；中国共产党创始人李大钊与保守派共席——'新旧并用'不是姿态而是用人事实
答林琴南函（1919）：面对'覆孔孟、铲伦常'的攻击，蔡以'大学为研究学问之机关，非都督府'作答，声明绝无'自除'异己之意——为激进新派挡住了政治压力
反面警示：包容边界失守的教训——民初部分院校把'兼容'做成了'来者不拒'，学阀各霸一门、互不往来，'并存'而无'比较'；蔡的批评恰是并存必须有共同赛场：无比较的并存是割据，不是自由
representative_cases_en: Under one roof at Peking University: Chen Duxiu and Hu Shi championing the vernacular taught alongside Qin-dynasty loyalist Gu Hongming (queue and all) lecturing in English literature, and Liu Shipei; the degreeless Liang Shuming was hired to lecture on Indian philosophy; Li Dazhao, founder of Chinese communism, shared the faculty with conservatives — 'old and new side by side' was a staffing fact, not a gesture.

The reply to Lin Shu, 1919: attacked for 'toppling Confucius and uprooting ethics,' Cai answered that 'the university is an institution for the study of learning, not a military governor's yamen,' disclaiming any intent to purge dissenters — using his office to shield the radical new school from political pressure.

Cautionary counterexample: the failure mode of a breached boundary — some early-Republican academies made 'inclusion' mean 'admit everyone,' with academic barons each squatting on a fief, coexisting but never comparing. Cai's point was that coexistence requires a shared arena: coexistence without comparison is warlordism, not freedom.
modern_applications_zh: 组织技术路线并存：同一团队内允许两条技术路线并行立项、公开对比数据——用赛马代替路线斗争，裁判只守'数据真实'
媒体与社区治理：把言论边界写在'可检验、有依据'而非'立场正确'上，异见与谣言区别对待
企业决策的'红队'制度化：重大方案强制配置反方论证组，让对立观点获得编制与资源——包容不是口头美德而是预算科目
学术评审去立场化：评审标准明文化为'论证与证据'，禁止以研究者身份立场为拒稿理由
modern_applications_en: Parallel tech tracks: allow two competing technical routes to run funded in parallel and compare data in public — horse-racing instead of route warfare, with the referee guarding only data integrity.
Media and community governance: set the speech boundary at 'testable and evidenced' rather than 'politically correct,' treating dissent and disinformation differently.
Institutionalized red teams: every major proposal gets a funded opposing-argument unit — inclusion as a budget line, not a spoken virtue.
De-politicized peer review: criteria codified as 'argument and evidence,' with rejection-by-identity-or-stance explicitly banned.

陈独秀、胡适（新派受益者与推进者）
辜鸿铭、刘师培（被包容的旧派实证）
约翰·密尔（思想自由竞争论的哲理先驱）
modes.key_quote_zh: 无论为何种学派，苟其言之成理，持之有故，尚不达自然淘汰之运命者，虽彼此相反，而悉听其自由发展。
modes.key_quote_en: Whatever the school of thought, if it reasons soundly and holds evidence, and has not yet met the fate of natural elimination, then though it contradict its neighbor, it is free to develop.

modes.name_en: Five-Fold Education: Keeping the Ends Plural
modes.definition_zh: 1912年蔡元培发表《对于新教育之意见》，提出军国民教育、实利主义、公民道德、世界观、美育五育并举——这是中国教育史上第一次系统拒绝'单一教育目的'：清学部旧宗旨以'忠君、尊孔'为纲，是把一切教育收束于一个政治目的；蔡的五育则是一个多元结构，'五者以公民道德为中坚'但互相不可归约。方法论签名有三：其一，目的多元且分层——体力（军国民）、生计（实利）、伦理（道德）、超越（世界观）、情感（美育）各居其位，任何一育独大即成畸形（他明言军国民教育在'强邻环伺'下必要、在承平时当退）；其二，反对目的绑架——教育目的若被单一宗旨（无论忠君、富国还是革命）独占，教育即沦为工具，'教育者，与其守成法，毋宁尚自然'；其三，中坚而非中心——道德居'中坚'是黏合剂而非最高目的，五育是网状平衡而非金字塔等级。这一模式把'教育为谁、为何'的问题从政纲争夺改写为结构设计问题。
modes.definition_en: In 1912 Cai Yuanpei published 'On the New Education,' proposing five parallel aims — military-civic, utilitarian, civic-moral, world-view, and aesthetic education — the first systematic Chinese rejection of a single educational purpose: the old Qing curriculum made 'loyalty to the sovereign and veneration of Confucius' its twin cables, collapsing all education into one political end. Cai's five aims form a plural structure 'with civic morality as the bond,' each irreducible to the others. Three signatures define the mode. First, plural and layered ends: body (military-civic), livelihood (utilitarian), ethics (moral), transcendence (world-view), and feeling (aesthetic) each hold their place; any one aim swelling to dominance deforms the whole — he noted explicitly that military-civic education was necessary 'encircled by strong neighbors' and should recede in peace. Second, against purpose-kidnapping: if education's ends are monopolized by a single program — loyalism, national wealth, or revolution alike — education becomes an instrument. Third, bond, not apex: morality as the 'bond' is glue, not the supreme goal; the five aims form a networked balance, not a pyramid. The mode rewrites 'education for whom, toward what' from a contest of platforms into a problem of structural design.
modes.source_chapter: 蔡元培《对于新教育之意见》（1912年4月，初刊《东方杂志》）；壬子癸丑学制起草说明
process_zh: 盘点目的清单：列出机构/个人当前实际追逐的所有目的（权力、收入、声誉、成长、审美），标出哪些被明文化、哪些被默认
识别单极化：找出独大的目的——凡考核只认一育（只看分数、只看营收、只看服从），即预告畸形正在发生
补设缺席之育：对照五育结构，把长期缺席的维度（身体、审美、伦理、超越）写入制度化的预算与考核，而非写进口号
定期再平衡：环境变化时主动升降各育权重（战时军国民升、承平时降），把目的结构当活文档管理
process_en: Inventory the aims: list every purpose the institution or person actually chases (power, revenue, reputation, growth, beauty); mark which are codified and which are tacit.
Detect monoculture: find the swollen aim — wherever assessment honors only one dimension (scores alone, revenue alone, obedience alone), deformity is already underway.
Restore the missing aims: against the five-fold template, write the long-absent dimensions (body, aesthetics, ethics, transcendence) into budgets and assessment, not into slogans.
Rebalance on schedule: when circumstances shift, raise and lower each aim's weight deliberately (military-civic up in war, down in peace) — manage the aim structure as a living document.
representative_cases_zh: 1912年教育方针：民国教育部废除'忠君、尊孔'两纲，以五育颁行全国——军国民以卫体、实利以卫生计、道德以立群己、世界观以接超越、美育以陶情感，第一次把'人'而不是'臣民'设为教育产出
蔡对军国民教育的限权设计：他明言此育是'强邻交逼'时代的应急，'他日国际战事既息'当以'体育'之名存其身体训练之实——目的可以升降，不可以独裁
反面警示：五育失衡的世纪教训——后续时代反复出现的'唯分数''唯升学'把实利一育推到畸形独大，身体、情感、伦理被挤出课表；蔡1901年即批评旧教育'以科名仕进为鹄的'，一百年后结构换了名称（应试）而结构未变：单极化的引力永远存在，多元结构须靠制度而非觉悟维持
representative_cases_en: The 1912 national policy: the Ministry abolished the twin cables of 'loyalty and Confucian veneration' and promulgated the five aims — military-civic for the body, utilitarian for livelihood, moral for community, world-view for transcendence, aesthetic for feeling — making 'the person,' not 'the subject,' education's output for the first time.

Deliberate throttling: Cai stated that military-civic education was an emergency measure under 'encirclement by strong neighbors,' to keep only its physical-training substance 'when international war subsides' — aims may rise and fall by design, never rule by decree.

Cautionary counterexample: a century of imbalance — recurring 'score-only' and 'exam-only' regimes pushed the utilitarian aim into deformed dominance, squeezing body, feeling, and ethics off the timetable. Cai attacked the old education for taking 'exam honors and officialdom' as its target in 1901; a hundred years later the structure renamed itself (test-prep) but did not change: monoculture's gravity is permanent, and plural structure must be maintained by institutions, not good intentions.
modern_applications_zh: 公司目标多元化设计：OKR之外强制写入'健康度指标'（员工身心、客户信任、生态影响），防止单一营收指标吞噬组织
个人发展五育自查：职业规划同时回答身体、生计、伦理、意义、审美五问——任何一问长年无投入即预警
学校'第五育'排课：把美育与体育写进不可挪用的刚性课表（对抗'主科挤占'），制度化而非倡议化
政策评估多维化：重大政策同时评估经济效益、公平、情感与文化影响，防止单维政绩竞赛
modern_applications_en: Plural corporate aims: beyond OKRs, mandate 'health metrics' (staff wellbeing, customer trust, ecosystem impact) to keep a single revenue aim from swallowing the organization.
A personal five-fold audit: in career planning answer five questions — body, livelihood, ethics, meaning, aesthetics; any question unfunded for years is an early warning.
Scheduling the 'fifth aim': write arts and PE into non-raidable timetable blocks (against 'main-subject encroachment') — institutionalized, not aspirational.
Multi-dimensional policy evaluation: assess major policies simultaneously for economic, equity, emotional, and cultural effects, forestalling single-metric trophy races.

亚里士多德（'全面培养'的古典源头）
席勒（美育书简的美学先声）
小原国芳（全人教育的同时代对照）
modes.key_quote_zh: 五者以公民道德为中坚，盖世界观及美育皆所以促进道德之手段，而教育者则循此五者以为鹄的者也。
modes.key_quote_en: Of the five, civic morality is the bond: world-view and aesthetic education are means that advance morality, and the educator takes all five together as the target.

modes.domain_zh: 教育学/美学与情感教育
modes.definition_zh: 蔡元培1917年提出'以美育代宗教'：人类情感的两种满足方式——宗教是情感与'知识、意志'捆绑的装置（把对未知与至善的追寻锁进教义），美育则是情感的纯粹形式（无强迫、无教义、普遍可入）。方法论签名有三：其一，功能分析替代实体之争——不辩论宗教真伪，而分析宗教 historically 承担的功能（情感安顿、超越感、共同体）能否被别的装置以更低的强制成本承担——'莫如舍宗教而易以纯粹之美育'；其二，陶养而非灌输——美育通过'非功利的观照'（康德-席勒一线）陶养感情，使'高尚纯洁'成为习惯而非戒律；其三，普遍性判据——美是'普遍而不涉利害'的，因此以美为载体能承载最广泛的共同体情感，而宗教的'神圣/异端'二分天然制造排他。这一模式把情感教育从信仰问题改写为制度选择问题：为人心安顿选一种低强制、高普遍性的公共装置。
modes.definition_en: In 1917 Cai Yuanpei proposed 'replacing religion with aesthetic education': humanity's two devices for meeting emotional needs — religion binds feeling to doctrine and cognition, locking the quest for the unknown and the supreme good inside dogma; aesthetic education is the pure form of feeling, unforced, undogmatic, universally accessible. Three signatures define the mode. First, functional analysis instead of an ontological quarrel: he never argued whether religion is true; he asked whether the functions religion historically carried (emotional shelter, transcendence, community) can be carried by another device at lower coercive cost — 'nothing is better than to set religion aside in favor of pure aesthetic education.' Second, cultivation, not indoctrination: aesthetic education refines feeling through 'disinterested contemplation' (the Kant-Schiller line), making the 'lofty and pure' a habit rather than a commandment. Third, the universality criterion: beauty is 'universal and disinterested,' so as a carrier it can host the widest communal feeling, while religion's sacred/heretic binary structurally produces exclusion. The mode rewrites emotional education from a question of faith into a question of institutional choice: choose for the human heart a public device of low coercion and high universality.
modes.source_chapter: 蔡元培《以美育代宗教说》（1917年在北京神州学会演讲，刊《新青年》）；《文化运动不要忘了美育》（1921）
process_zh: 功能拆解：把'宗教/传统装置'承担的真实功能列成清单（安顿焦虑、意义感、共同仪式、道德动机），承认功能真实存在——直接否定功能则方案无人需要
寻找低强制替代：为每项功能寻找强制成本更低、准入更普遍的公共替代（音乐会代替礼拜的安顿功能、美术馆代替教堂的超越功能）
把替代制度化：替代品必须进入公共供给（学校课程、城市设施、社区仪式），而非留给个人偶然遇见——'文化运动不要忘了美育'即此警告
检验排他性：定期审计替代装置是否又长出教义与门槛（审美鄙视链、艺术圈层化），一有苗头即重申普遍性判据
process_en: Decompose the functions: list the real functions the religious/traditional device carries (calming anxiety, meaning, communal ritual, moral motivation) and admit they are real — denying the functions leaves your proposal with no customers.
Find lower-coercion substitutes: for each function, find a public substitute of lower coercive cost and wider access (the concert hall for the shelter function, the museum for transcendence).

Institutionalize the substitutes: substitutes must enter public provision (school curricula, city facilities, community ritual), not be left to chance encounters — his warning 'in the cultural movement, do not forget aesthetic education.'

Audit for re-exclusion: periodically check whether the substitute has grown its own dogma and thresholds (taste hierarchies, art-world gatekeeping) and reassert the universality criterion at the first sign.
representative_cases_zh: 北大美育建制：任校长期间办音乐研究会、画法研究会、书法研究会，聘名家授课并给学分——把美育从'士人雅趣'变成课程表上的正式供给，这是'美育'第一次进入中国大学的制度结构
《以美育代宗教说》的论证现场：面对新文化运动'反宗教'与'保教'的拉锯，蔡把战场从'宗教该不该反'挪到'情感安顿该用什么装置'——绕开了信仰战争，直接给人心找替代方案
反面警示：美育供给长期不足的后果——他1921年警告'文化运动不要忘了美育'，此后百年公共美育供给反复欠账，大众情感安顿的市场被低质娱乐与极端思潮填补：情感需求不会消失，只会在供给缺位时流向强制性与排他性更高的装置——这是'美育代宗教'未完成部分的现代证词
representative_cases_en: Building aesthetics into Peking University: as president he founded societies for music, painting, and calligraphy, hired masters, and granted credit — moving aesthetic education from 'gentlemanly taste' to formal supply on the curriculum, its first entry into a Chinese university's institutional structure.

The site of the argument: amid the New Culture Movement's tug-of-war over religion, Cai moved the battlefield from 'should religion be opposed' to 'what device should meet emotional needs' — bypassing the war of faiths and offering the heart a substitute directly.

Cautionary counterexample: the cost of undersupply — he warned in 1921 that 'the cultural movement must not forget aesthetic education'; over the following century public provision kept falling short, and the market for emotional shelter was filled by low-grade entertainment and extremist currents: emotional demand never disappears; when supply is absent it flows to devices of higher coercion and exclusion — a modern testimony to the unfinished part of 'aesthetic education replacing religion.'
modern_applications_zh: 平台内容生态设计：把'意义感、归属感'列为显性供给指标，防止情感需求全部流向极端化内容（现代版'美育代宗教'的运营学）
城市公共空间美育：图书馆、美术馆、公园的免费美学供给被视作社会情绪基础设施预算，而非文化点缀
组织仪式替代设计：用无教义的公共仪式（复盘会、纪念活动、艺术日）承担团队情感与意义功能，替代隐性的'公司崇拜'
个人情绪治理：把'定期看展/听音乐会/接触自然'列为与锻炼同级的刚性自我供给，而非有闲才做
modern_applications_en: Platform content ecology: treat 'meaning and belonging' as explicit supply metrics, keeping emotional demand from draining wholly into radicalizing content — the operating science of 'aesthetic education replacing religion.'
Civic aesthetic infrastructure: free aesthetic provision in libraries, museums, and parks budgeted as social-emotional infrastructure, not cultural garnish.
Substitute rituals for organizations: dogma-free public rituals (retrospectives, commemorations, art days) carrying the team's emotional and meaning functions in place of tacit 'company worship.'
Personal emotional governance: schedule museums, concerts, and nature as rigid self-supply ranked with exercise, not a leisure-time leftover.

康德（'无利害的愉悦'之哲理来源）
席勒（《美育书简》的直接思想资源）
王国维（中国美学教育的同路先行者）
modes.key_quote_zh: 鉴激刺感情之弊，而专尚陶养感情之术，则莫如舍宗教而易以纯粹之美育。纯粹之美育，所以陶养吾人之感情，使有高尚纯洁之习惯。
modes.key_quote_en: Seeing the evils of emotionally inflaming devices, the best art of cultivating feeling is to set religion aside in favor of pure aesthetic education, which refines our emotions until the lofty and pure become habit.

modes.name_en: Faculty Governance: Separating Powers in the University
modes.domain_zh: 高等教育/大学治理制度
modes.definition_zh: 蔡元培把'教授治校'从口号落成中国大学的第一套分权章程：北大设评议会（立法，评议员由教授互选）、各系教授会（教学与课程，系主任教授互选）、行政会议（执行，校长主持）——学术立法、教学自治、行政执行三权分置，'谁有资格决定课程与聘任'的答案从'官方任命'改为'教员共同体'。方法论签名有三：其一，权力跟着专长走——学术事务的立法权交给最能判断学术的人（教授互选），而非资历或官阶；其二，先立规则再授权——评议会章程先于权力下放，授权同时立法（评议员任期、议事规则、弹劾条款俱全），防止分权退化为元老会；其三，行政保持可问责——校长保留执行与对外代表权但受评议会约束，'教授治校'不等于教授行政：专长分工而非职位合并。这一模式是现代中国大学治理的制度原型，其设计与公司治理中的董事会-管理层分立同构。
modes.definition_en: Cai Yuanpei turned 'faculty governance' from slogan into the first separation-of-powers charter in a Chinese university: at Peking University he established the University Council (legislative, members elected by the professors), departmental faculty meetings (teaching and curriculum, chairs elected), and the administrative conference (execution, presided by the president) — academic legislation, teaching self-rule, and administrative execution placed in three separate hands, so that 'who is qualified to decide curriculum and hiring' changed its answer from 'official appointment' to 'the faculty community.' Three signatures define the mode. First, power follows expertise: legislative authority over academic affairs goes to those best able to judge scholarship (elected professors), not to seniority or rank. Second, rules before delegation: the council charter precedes devolution — term limits, procedural rules, and removal clauses are legislated together with the grant of power, keeping 'faculty governance' from decaying into a gerontocracy. Third, administration stays accountable: the president retains execution and external representation but is bound by the council — 'faculty governance' never meant professors running errands: a division of expertise, not a merger of offices. The mode is the institutional prototype of modern Chinese university governance, structurally isomorphic to the board-versus-management split in corporate governance.
modes.source_chapter: 蔡元培主持《北京大学评议会规则》《各系教授会组织法》（1917-1919）；《大学令》（1912）评议会条款
process_zh: 划定学术事务清单：把'必须由专业共同体决定'的事项（课程、聘任标准、学位、学术评价）从行政清单中单列——清单不清，分权必被行政稀释
起草先于授权：写好评议员产生办法、任期、议事规则、对违规成员的处理条款，再交出权力——先立法后分权，顺序不可颠倒
互选而非任命：评议员与系主任一律由教员互选产生，使权力来源是共同体而非上级——来源决定问责方向
行政与立法互锁：校长掌握执行与对外代表，但重大学术决策须过评议会——用制度互锁替代人事制衡
process_en: Demarcate the academic ledger: single out the matters only the professional community may decide (curriculum, hiring standards, degrees, scholarly evaluation) from the administrative list — an unclear ledger gets diluted by administration.

Draft before delegating: write the rules for electing council members, terms of office, procedure, and discipline BEFORE handing over power — legislate first, devolve second; the order cannot be reversed.

Elect, never appoint: council members and department chairs are elected by the faculty, so power's source is the community, not a superior — the source of power determines the direction of accountability.

Interlock administration and legislation: the president keeps execution and external representation, but major academic decisions must pass the council — replace personnel checks with institutional interlocking.
representative_cases_zh: 北大1917-1919章程落地：评议会（教授互选代表）成为学校最高立法机构，废门改系后各系设教授会互选系主任，行政会议统筹执行——中国大学第一次有了'学术立法权在教员'的成文制度
《大学令》（1912）先行立法：早在北大任职前，蔡任教育总长时已把'大学设评议会'写进国家学位法令——他懂得制度原型要抢在人事博弈之前固化
反面警示：教授治校的退化形态——后续时代评议会或被停摆、或被行政加委：同一批词汇（'教授治校''学术委员会'）在无互选与议事保障时变成装饰；历史证明分权设计最脆弱的环节是'产生办法'：任命产生的'教授代表'是行政的回声，互选产生的才是共同体
representative_cases_en: The charter lands, 1917-1919: the University Council (professor-elected) became the university's supreme legislative body; after abolishing 'divisions' for 'departments,' each department elected its chair through a faculty meeting; the administrative conference coordinated execution — for the first time a Chinese university had a written rule placing academic legislation in faculty hands.

Legislate before you preside: as Minister of Education in 1912 — before ever taking Peking University — Cai wrote 'the university shall have a council' into the national degree decree, knowing institutional prototypes must be fixed before personnel battles begin.

Cautionary counterexample: the degenerate forms — later eras suspended councils or appointed their members; the same vocabulary ('faculty governance,' 'academic committee') becomes decoration without elections and procedural guarantees. History shows the fragile link of any separation design is the method of selection: an appointed 'faculty representative' echoes the administration; an elected one speaks for the community.
modern_applications_zh: 技术组织架构评审会：架构决策权交给互选的技术评议会而非单一CTO拍板，行政线保留执行否决但受章程约束
开源基金会治理：committer 互选 TSC（技术委员会），基金会行政与社区技术立法分立——CNCF/ASF 的模式正是'教授治校'的软件版
医院与律所合伙人制：专业事务由合伙人会议立法、管理合伙人执行——专业共同体的分权原型
公司学术型实验室：研究方向预算由研究员评议会分配，管理层只控总额与合规
modern_applications_en: Architecture review councils: architecture decision rights go to an elected technical council rather than a lone CTO, with the executive line retaining veto on execution but bound by charter.
Open-source foundation governance: committers elect the TSC; foundation administration and community technical legislation stay separate — CNCF/ASF practice is faculty governance in software form.
Hospital and law-firm partnerships: professional matters legislated by the partnership meeting, executed by managing partners — the classic separation prototype for professional communities.
Corporate research labs: research budgets allocated by a researchers' council; management controls only totals and compliance.

modes.key_quote_zh: 大学以评议会为立法机关，以各系教授会为教学自治之机关，行政会议掌执行——皆所以使大学教授得与其职守相称之权力。
modes.key_quote_en: The university takes the council as its legislature, the departmental faculty meetings as its organs of teaching self-rule, and the administrative conference as its executive — all so that professors may hold power proportionate to their charge.

modes.domain_zh: 高等教育/人才评价与聘任
modes.domain_en: Higher Education / Talent Evaluation and Appointment
modes.definition_zh: 蔡元培的用人革命是把人才评价的唯一筹码从'身份与立场'换成'研究之成绩'：'人才主义'——只要学问立得住，无学位的梁漱溟可聘讲印度哲学（他只是佛学自学的中学毕业生）、24岁的胡适可任教授、拖着辫子的辜鸿铭可留任英国文学、宣扬无政府主义的李石曾与倡共产的李大钊可同校——'囊括大典，网罗众家'。方法论签名有三：其一，单一判据——聘任只问'这一门学问他是否是目前最好的人选'，学历、资历、立场全部降为不问项；其二，不回避不可爱——他明知某些人（辜鸿铭的帝制言论、刘师培的失节史）立场可憎，仍以'持之有故'留任：机构的天职是学问而非道德审查，道德问题用进德会等自愿团体处理而非用人事处理；其三，以新带旧而非除旧——不清洗旧派，而是注入足量的新派使天平重置，让竞争而非人事完成淘汰。这一模式把'用人'从站队问题改写为学术采购问题：为学问买最好的供给，不问供给者的立场颜色。
modes.definition_en: Cai Yuanpei's revolution in hiring was to swap the sole currency of talent from 'identity and stance' to 'demonstrated scholarship': by 'talent principle' — anyone whose learning holds up could be hired. The degreeless Liang Shuming (a self-taught secondary-school graduate in Buddhism) was appointed to lecture on Indian philosophy; Hu Shi at 24 became a professor; Gu Hongming, queue intact, kept his chair in English literature; the anarchist Li Shizeng and the communist Li Dazhao served in the same faculty — 'embrace the great canon, gather all schools.' Three signatures define the mode. First, a single criterion: appointment asks only 'is he the best available in this subject?' — degrees, seniority, and political stance are all demoted to non-questions. Second, not shunning the unlovable: he knew some men's politics were repellent (Gu's monarchism, Liu Shipei's record of betrayal) yet retained them for 'held evidence' — the institution's duty is learning, not moral screening; moral questions are handled by voluntary bodies like the Virtue Society, not by personnel decisions. Third, rebalancing by addition, not purge: he did not cleanse the old school; he injected enough of the new to reset the balance, letting competition rather than personnel do the eliminating. The mode rewrites 'staffing' from a question of alignment into a question of academic procurement: buy the best supply for learning, regardless of the supplier's colors.
modes.source_chapter: 蔡元培《致〈公言报〉函并答林琴南函》（1919年3月）；《我在北京大学的经历》；北大聘任档案（梁漱溟、胡适、陈独秀诸例）
process_zh: 重写聘任判据：把岗位要求从'资历/学历/立场'改写为'该学科当前最好的人选是谁'——判据单一化是人才重估的前提
搜寻非典型供给：主动到体制外找（报刊撰稿人、自学者、留学生、旧学者），名校履历只是信号之一而非门槛
隔离立场噪音：对候选人做'学问审查'而非'背景审查'——其观点越可憎越须问'论据如何'，把道德争议转给自愿自律组织
用注入代替清洗：不驱旧派，而按缺口补强新派，让公开竞争自然重置力量对比——人事革命由竞争完成，不由解雇完成
process_en: Rewrite the hiring criterion: change the job requirement from 'credentials/seniority/alignment' to 'who is the best available in this subject' — a single criterion is the precondition of revaluation.
Hunt atypical supply: search outside the establishment (columnists, autodidacts, returned students, old-school scholars); a famous school's line on the CV is one signal, not a gate.

Isolate stance noise: run a 'scholarship review,' not a 'background check' — the more repellent the view, the more insistently ask 'what is the evidence'; route moral disputes to voluntary self-discipline bodies.
Add, don't purge: instead of expelling the old school, reinforce the new at the gaps and let open competition reset the balance — a personnel revolution completed by competition, not by dismissal.
representative_cases_zh: 梁漱溟特聘（1917）：印度哲学家 asking 无学历的中学毕业生因一篇《究元决疑论》被蔡破格聘为北大讲席——中国现代学术史上'以文聘人'的标志性案例，打破了'教授须有学位'的隐形门槛
新旧同堂的聘任清单：陈独秀（文科学长）、胡适（24岁教授）、李大钊（图书馆主任兼讲席）与辜鸿铭、刘师培、黄侃同校领薪——用一份聘书名单完成'网罗众家'的制度承诺
反面警示：单一判据的滥用形态——'人才主义'若失去'言之成理'的学理底线就会滑向唯名是举：后来各校竞聘'名人'挂名讲席而不问授课实绩，恰是蔡警告过的'资格主义'的镜像；人才重估须两腿：判据单一（只问学问）+ 底线坚硬（须有实绩）
representative_cases_en: The special appointment of Liang Shuming, 1917: a degreeless secondary-school graduate, hired to a Peking University lectureship in Indian philosophy on the strength of one essay ('On the Origin of Doubt and Its Resolution') — the landmark 'hire by writing' case in modern Chinese scholarship, breaking the tacit 'professors must hold degrees' gate.

The hiring ledger old and new: Chen Duxiu (dean of letters), Hu Shi (professor at 24), Li Dazhao (library director and lecturer) drawing the same payroll as Gu Hongming, Liu Shipei, and Huang Kan — one appointment list fulfilling the institutional pledge of 'gathering all schools.'

Cautionary counterexample: the abuse of a single criterion — without the hard floor of 'sound reasoning with evidence,' the 'talent principle' slides into name-chasing: later academies competing to bolt celebrities onto lecture rosters regardless of teaching substance is the mirror image of the credentialism Cai attacked. Talent revaluation stands on two legs: a single criterion (learning only) and a hard floor (substantive performance required).
modern_applications_zh: 招聘去学历化：把 JD 的'985/硕士'门槛改为'作品与实绩审查'（公开代码、可验证项目、同行推荐信），对冲文凭通胀
专家库竞争采购：关键岗位同时面试新旧两种背景的候选人并公开评分维度，防止近亲繁殖
'不可爱但能干'治理：对争议专家设行为边界（伦理委员会处理其行为）而非一票否决其专业贡献——机构对专业与品行分别问责
内部人才市场：晋升答辩只认'解决了什么问题'的实绩清单，工龄与头衔不进入评分表
modern_applications_en: Credential-blind hiring: replace 'top-school/master's' gates in job descriptions with portfolio review (public code, verifiable projects, peer letters), hedging credential inflation.
Competitive procurement of experts: for critical roles, interview candidates of both old and new backgrounds side by side with published scoring dimensions, countering inbreeding.

Governance for 'unlovable but able': set behavioral boundaries for controversial experts (ethics committee handles conduct) without vetoing their professional contribution — the institution holds expertise and conduct separately accountable.
An internal talent market: promotion boards score only a track record of 'problems solved'; tenure and title stay off the scoring sheet.

modes.key_quote_zh: 人才主义：对于教员，以学诣为主，使其在校内各展所长，毫无障碍。……囊括大典，网罗众家，思想自由，兼容并包。
modes.key_quote_en: The talent principle: for faculty, scholarship is the master criterion, so that each may unfold his strengths within the school without hindrance... embrace the great canon, gather all schools, freedom of thought, inclusiveness toward all.

modes.name_en: The Virtue Society: Self-Discipline as Institution
modes.domain_zh: 伦理学/组织道德制度设计
modes.domain_en: Ethics / Institutional Design of Organizational Morality
modes.definition_zh: 蔡元培1918年在北大发起进德会，把道德改革从训诫改写为自愿入会的公开承诺制度：会员分甲乙丙丁四种戒约（甲种：不嫖、不赌、不娶妾；乙加不作官吏、不作议员；丙加不吸烟、不饮酒；丁加不食肉），蔡自任会长并率先以甲种入会。方法论签名有三：其一，自愿与分档——道德义务按承受能力分档选择，'不责人以所不能'，把道德从统一强加改为自选承诺，入会即接受监督；其二，公开性即约束——会员名单与戒约公示，违反者'书其名于簿'，用声誉机制而非惩罚机制执行；其三，领导先入——道德改革的第一步是发起人自己入会并公示，'以身作则'从美德说教变成可核查的程序事实。这一模式与陶行知'捧着一颗心来'的信托伦理同向而机制不同：陶靠人格示范，蔡靠制度设计——道德的规模化要靠制度而非圣贤。
modes.definition_en: In 1918 Cai Yuanpei founded the Virtue Society (Jindehui) at Peking University, rewriting moral reform from exhortation into a system of voluntary, public, membership-based commitment: members chose among four graded pledges (A: no brothels, no gambling, no concubines; B adds: no official posts, no parliamentary seats; C adds: no smoking, no drinking; D adds: no meat), with Cai as founding president taking grade A first. Three signatures define the mode. First, voluntariness with grading: moral obligations are tiered by capacity — 'demand from no one what he cannot do' — converting morality from uniform imposition into self-selected commitment; joining means accepting oversight. Second, publicity is the constraint: member rosters and pledges were posted, violators 'recorded by name in the book,' enforced by reputation rather than punishment. Third, leaders join first: the first step of moral reform is the founder's own signed, public membership — 'leading by example' turned from a sermon on virtue into a verifiable procedural fact. The mode points the same way as Tao Xingzhi's trustee ethics ('a whole heart, no blade of grass') but differs in mechanism: Tao relied on personal exemplarity, Cai on institutional design — morality at scale requires institutions, not sages.
modes.source_chapter: 蔡元培《北京大学进德会旨趣书》（1918年1月）；《进德会会章》；北大日刊登载之会员名录
process_zh: 把美德翻译成条款：把组织希望的行为（廉洁、节制、敬业）写成具体可核查的戒条，越具体越可执行——'不收受供应商馈赠'优于'保持廉洁'
分档自愿选择：按承受力设多档承诺（基础档人人可为，进阶档自愿加码），让不同处境者都能以承诺入场
公示与记录：会员名单、承诺内容、违反记录全部公开——声誉是比罚款更便宜的执行机制，但只对公开的承诺生效
发起人先入：规则的倡导者第一个签字公示——自上而下的道德动员若无倡导者自缚条款，必被识破为'道德他人化'
process_en: Translate virtues into clauses: write the behaviors the organization wants (integrity, moderation, diligence) as concrete, checkable pledges — 'accept no gifts from vendors' beats 'remain incorruptible.'
Grade and volunteer: offer tiered commitments by capacity (a base tier anyone can take, higher tiers opt-in), so people in every situation can enter through commitment.
Publish and record: rosters, pledge contents, and violation records all public — reputation is cheaper enforcement than fines, but works only on public commitments.
Founders sign first: the rule's advocate signs and posts first — top-down moral mobilization without the advocate's own binding pledge is exposed as moralizing at others.
representative_cases_zh: 北大进德会（1918）：发起数月会员近三百人，李石曾、王建祖等名教授与众多学生入会，甲乙丙丁各档公示于《北大日刊》；蔡元培自任会长列甲种会员——道德改革第一次以'会员制+公示制'在大学运行
'不责人以所不能'的分档设计：把'不作官吏、不作议员'设为乙种自愿项而非全体义务——承认知识人有参政的权利与责任，只是入会者自愿约束之；分档使道德运动免于变成道德绑架
反面警示：声誉机制的天花板——进德会后期多有名存实亡之讥：公示制约束的是'在意声誉的人'，对无所谓者失效；且'不作官'档在时局下被讥为清谈。历史证明自愿自律是道德的'增益机制'而非'保底机制'——底线仍须规则与问责，自律只能在底线之上加高
representative_cases_en: The Peking University Virtue Society, 1918: within months nearly three hundred members — famous professors like Li Shizeng and Wang Jianzu among many students — with all four pledge grades posted in the Peking University Daily; Cai signed on as president in grade A. Moral reform ran for the first time in a university on a 'membership-plus-publicity' system.

Grading by 'demand from no one what he cannot do': making 'no official posts, no parliamentary seats' a voluntary grade-B option rather than a universal duty — acknowledging intellectuals' right and duty to engage in politics while letting members self-bind; grading kept the moral movement from becoming moral hostage-taking.

Cautionary counterexample: the ceiling of reputation — the society was later mocked as existing in name only: publicity binds those who care about reputation and fails on those who do not, and the 'no office' grade was derided as idle talk amid the times. History shows voluntary self-discipline is a gain mechanism above the floor, never the floor itself: baseline rules and accountability must stand beneath it.
modern_applications_zh: 企业廉洁承诺分层：从'不收现金'（全员基础档）到'高管亲属回避'（进阶档）分档签署并公示，签署名单进入内网可查
开源社区行为准则：签署制+公示制（签署者名单公开、违反记录公开），比抽象公约更具约束力
领导先签：合规改革从CEO与创始团队的公示承诺开始——'治理由上'的第一证据是签名而非口号
行业协会自律名录：会员单位自愿申报标准并公示，超标者除名——把行业道德做成可检索的声誉资产
modern_applications_en: Tiered corporate integrity pledges: from 'no cash gifts' (universal base tier) to 'executive conflict-of-interest recusal' (opt-in tier), signed, posted, and searchable on the intranet.
Open-source codes of conduct: signature-plus-publication (signed roster public, violation records public) binds harder than an abstract covenant.
Leaders sign first: compliance reform starts with the CEO's and founding team's published pledges — the first evidence of 'tone at the top' is a signature, not a slogan.
Industry self-regulation rosters: member firms voluntarily declare standards and publish them, with expulsion for breaches — industry ethics as a searchable reputation asset.

modes.key_quote_zh: 本会不责人以至善，而先去其分明之恶；不责人以所不能，而先勉人以所能。……会员之戒约，皆自愿之公约也。
modes.key_quote_en: The Society demands not the highest good but the removal of manifest evils; it demands from no one what he cannot do, and first strives for what all can do... every member's pledges are a voluntarily made covenant.

modes.name_en: Work-Study: Rebuilding the Cost of Opportunity
modes.domain_zh: 教育经济学/机会成本设计
modes.domain_en: Economics of Education / Cost Design of Opportunity
modes.definition_zh: 蔡元培与李石曾1916年在巴黎创办华法教育会，把'留学'从少数富家子弟的特权改写为'勤于做工、俭以求学'的群众路线：以工时换学费，'以最俭之费用，求最多之留学'。方法论签名有三：其一，成本结构拆解——把留学的总成本拆成学费、生活费、语言、信息四项，逐项寻找可由'劳动'替代支付的项——'以工代费'让劳动成为货币的替代品而非补充；其二，规模普惠判据——任何机会设计的成败以其覆盖面而非其精英高度衡量，'以最俭之费用求最多之人数'；其三，信息与组织先行——设办事机构统一组织订舱、接站、工读安排，把个体移民的风险成本集中化摊薄（这一组织能力后来成为留法勤工俭学运动的基础设施：周恩来、邓小平、陈毅、聂荣臻皆循此路）。这一模式把'机会'从财富的函数改写为'劳动×组织'的函数，是现代教育机会设计（助学金、带薪实习、在职学位）的制度先声。
modes.definition_en: In 1916 Cai Yuanpei and Li Shizeng founded the Sino-French Education Association in Paris, rewriting 'studying abroad' from the privilege of wealthy sons into a mass route of 'work diligently, study frugally': wages for tuition — 'with the most frugal expense, seek the largest number studying abroad.' Three signatures define the mode. First, decompose the cost structure: split the total cost of study abroad into tuition, living, language, and information, then find for each item a component payable in labor rather than money — 'work in place of fees' makes labor a substitute for currency, not a supplement. Second, the universality criterion: an opportunity design is judged by its coverage, not its elite height — 'least expense, most people.' Third, information and organization first: a standing office centrally arranged berths, arrivals, and work-study placements, pooling and amortizing the risk costs of individual migration (this organizational capability became the infrastructure of the work-study-in-France movement: Zhou Enlai, Deng Xiaoping, Chen Yi, and Nie Rongzhen all came through it). The mode rewrites 'opportunity' from a function of wealth into a function of labor times organization — the institutional forerunner of modern opportunity design: scholarships, paid internships, degrees for working adults.
modes.source_chapter: 华法教育会章程与《旅欧教育运动》（1916，巴黎）；蔡元培《勤工俭学传》序（1915）；毛泽东、蔡和森等组织湖南留法之档案记载
key_concepts: 以最俭之费用求最多之留学
process_zh: 拆解机会成本：把目标机会（留学、转行、创业）的总成本拆成现金项与可劳动化项，标出哪些可以用时间与劳动替代支付
设计劳动-学习汇率：为可劳动化项定价（多少工时抵多少学费），并保证劳动本身不侵蚀学习（工种选择、工时上限）——汇率失真则'勤工'吞掉'俭学'
组织化摊薄风险：设统一机构处理批量事务（签证、接站、工读匹配），把个体承担的不确定性变成组织批量处理的可变成本
以覆盖面定成败：定期审计参与者的社会构成（家庭背景分布），若趋向精英化即调整资助与门槛——机会设计的目标是覆盖而非高度
process_en: Decompose the cost of opportunity: split the total cost of the target opportunity (study abroad, career change, founding) into cash items and laborizable items; mark which can be paid in time and work.

Design the labor-study exchange rate: price each laborizable item (hours of work per unit of tuition) and ensure the work does not eat the study (choice of job type, hour caps) — a distorted rate lets 'work' devour 'frugal study.'
Pool risk through organization: a standing office handles batch affairs (visas, arrivals, work-study matching), converting each individual's uncertainty into the organization's batched variable cost.

Judge by coverage: periodically audit the social composition of participants (family-background distribution); if it drifts elite, adjust subsidies and thresholds — opportunity design aims at coverage, not altitude.
representative_cases_zh: 华法教育会与留法运动的谱系（1912-1920）：从李石曾巴黎豆腐公司的'以工养学'试验，到华法教育会统一组织，再到全国20余省1700余名青年赴法——毛泽东经杨昌济知悉、蔡和森先期赴法、向警予周恩来邓小平相继循此路线；一次机会设计改写了一代人的命运
湖南新民学会的'组织化留学'：蔡和森等以学会为组织单元集体筹款、集体订舱、集体安排工读——个体不可能完成的迁移由组织完成，证明'机会'的瓶颈常在组织而非资金
反面警示：汇率失真的教训——1921年里昂中法大学的'入学事件'：勤工俭学生发现'以工换学'的承诺被单方面改写为精英选拔，数百学生被拒之门外；运动后期的经济危机中做工机会枯竭、'勤工'无法'俭学'——成本重构若失去契约保障与经济兜底，机会承诺即成空头支票
representative_cases_en: The genealogy from association to movement, 1912-1920: from Li Shizeng's 'earn to learn' experiment at his Paris tofu factory, to the Sino-French Education Association's centralized arrangements, to over 1,700 young people from more than 20 provinces sailing for France — Mao Zedong learned of it through Yang Changji, Cai Hesen went ahead, Xiang Jingyu, Zhou Enlai, and Deng Xiaohan followed; one opportunity design rewrote a generation's destiny.

Hunan's New People Study Society as organized emigration: Cai Hesen and colleagues used the society as an organizational cell to raise funds, book passages, and arrange work-study collectively — a migration no individual could manage was completed by organization, proving the bottleneck of opportunity is usually organization, not money.

Cautionary counterexample: the exchange rate failing — the 1921 Lyon incident: work-study students found the 'work-for-study' promise unilaterally rewritten into elite selection, with hundreds turned away; in the movement's later economic crisis jobs dried up and 'diligent work' could no longer buy 'frugal study.' Cost restructuring without contractual guarantees and economic backstops turns an opportunity pledge into a bounced check.
modern_applications_zh: 带薪学位与学徒制设计：把学历成本中的可劳动化部分（项目工作、助教、企业实训）定价并计入培养方案，让'边工作边获得资格'成为默认通道而非特例
普惠型出海/转行项目：设立统一机构处理签证、住处、本地对接，把个体试错成本组织化摊薄
'劳动抵学费'审计：任何以工换学项目须公开汇率与工时上限，防止劳动吞噬学习——里昂教训的合规版本
组织化求职：以社群为单元集体内推、集体复盘面试，个体就业市场的信息成本由组织摊薄
modern_applications_en: Salaried degrees and apprenticeships: price the laborizable share of tuition (project work, TAships, corporate training) into the program, making 'earn the credential while working' the default route, not the exception.
Universal mobility programs: a standing office handles visas, housing, and local matching, pooling individual trial-and-error costs.
'Work-for-tuition' audits: any earn-and-learn scheme must publish its exchange rate and hour caps so labor cannot swallow learning — the compliance version of the Lyon lesson.
Organized job search: communities pool referrals and interview retrospectives collectively, socializing the information cost of the individual job market.

李石曾（华法教育会共同创办人、豆腐公司试验者）
吴玉章（四川勤工俭学组织者）
罗伯特·欧文（工读结合实验的先驱）
modes.key_quote_zh: 勤于做工，俭以求学，以进劳动者之智识。……以最俭之费用，求最多之留学人数。
modes.key_quote_en: Work diligently, study frugally, and advance the laborer's knowledge... with the most frugal expense, seek the largest number of students abroad.

modes.name_en: Building Academia Sinica: National Research as an Institution
modes.domain_zh: 科学学/国家科研体制设计
modes.domain_en: Science of Science / National Research System Design
modes.definition_zh: 蔡元培1928年创建中央研究院并任首任院长，为中国建立第一个国家级科学研究体制：以'研究'而非'教学'立院（与大学分工互补），设物理、化学、工程、地质、历史语言等研究所，首创评议会制度筹备学术自治，并确立'学术'与'行政'两系列——研究员职级与行政职级分轨。方法论签名有三：其一，新功能须新机构——大学承担不了'纯研究'（教学挤压），蔡不改造旧机构而另立新机构：功能的空白由新建制填补而非旧瓶新酒；其二，以'所'为研究单元——按学科设所、所内设研究员制，把'研究'从个人趣味变成有职级、有预算、有同行评议会保障的职业；其三，国际标准内嵌——设名誉会员与通信研究员制度、出版西文期刊、参与国际学术会议，使新建制一开始就在国际学术共同体中有接口。这一模式是'学术国家化'的制度设计：一个国家要有独立的知识生产能力，需要与大学并立的专职研究建制。
modes.definition_en: In 1928 Cai Yuanpei founded Academia Sinica (the Central Research Institute) and served as its first president, building China's first national scientific research system: chartered for 'research' rather than 'teaching' (complementary to, not duplicative of, universities), with institutes of physics, chemistry, engineering, geology, history-and-philology and more, a pioneering council system to prepare for academic self-governance, and a dual ladder — research ranks separated from administrative ranks. Three signatures define the mode. First, new functions need new institutions: universities could not carry 'pure research' (teaching crowds it out); instead of retrofitting an old body Cai chartered a new one — functional gaps are filled by new establishments, not old bottles. Second, the institute as research unit: institutes by discipline with a researcher career track turned 'research' from private taste into a profession with ranks, budgets, and peer-council protection. Third, international standards embedded: corresponding-member systems, Western-language journals, and participation in international congresses gave the new establishment interfaces into the world scholarly community from day one. The mode is the institutional design of 'nationalizing scholarship': a nation that wants independent knowledge production needs a dedicated research establishment standing beside its universities.
modes.source_chapter: 《中央研究院组织法》（1928，国民政府公布）；蔡元培《中央研究院之使命》；傅斯年《历史语言研究所工作之旨趣》（蔡批准建制）
process_zh: 识别功能空白：盘点现有机构（大学、部属机关）承担不了的功能（纯研究、长期基础研究、国家层面知识安全），空白即新机构的正当性来源
立法先行：先争取组织法（法定地位、预算渠道、治理结构）再招人设所——建制没有法律骨架则随人事兴废
职业轨道设计：为'研究'设独立职级、任期与评价（研究员≠行政官），并设评议会保障学术评价权在共同体
装国际接口：出版外语期刊、设通信制度、参加国际会议，让新建制从出生日起在国际共同体中可被引用与检验
process_en: Spot the functional gap: inventory what existing bodies (universities, ministry bureaus) cannot carry — pure research, long-horizon basic science, national knowledge security; the gap is the charter's legitimacy.
Legislate first: secure the organic law (legal status, budget channel, governance) before hiring and founding institutes — an establishment without a legal skeleton rises and falls with personnel.
Design the professional track: give research its own ranks, tenure, and evaluation (researcher ≠ administrator), and a peer council that keeps scholarly evaluation in the community's hands.
Install international interfaces: foreign-language journals, corresponding members, congress participation — let the new establishment be citable and checkable in the world community from birth.
representative_cases_zh: 史语所的'上穷碧落下黄泉'（1928）：傅斯年执掌的历史语言研究所在蔡元培支持下把殷墟发掘、方言调查、内阁大库档案整理做成有预算、有团队、有出版物的国家项目——'动手动脚找东西'第一次成为国家供养的职业
评议会的制度筹备：蔡力主设评议会以'谋研究之自由与学术之独立'，虽因时局迟至1948年才选出首届院士，但制度设计在他任内已定型——国家科研体制的'立宪'先于其'选举'
反面警示：建制失于人事的教训——中研院早期经费常年拖欠、抗战中数度播迁，'国家研究体制'在战时近乎名存实亡；且蔡之后的院长更迭屡现行政侵蚀学术：历史证明组织法与评议会是两道防线，缺一则学术独立只剩宣言
representative_cases_en: The History-and-Philology Institute's 'to the highest heavens and the deepest springs,' 1928: under Fu Ssu-nien, with Cai's backing, the Yinxu excavations, dialect surveys, and Ming-Qing Grand Secretariat archives became state-funded projects with budgets, teams, and publications — 'digging with your own hands' a state-sustained profession for the first time.

Preparing the council's constitution: Cai insisted on a council 'to secure freedom of research and independence of scholarship'; though the first academicians were elected only in 1948 amid the times, the design was fixed in his tenure — a national research system is 'constituted' before it can 'elect.'

Cautionary counterexample: establishment lost to circumstance and personnel — early Academia Sinica was chronically unpaid, displaced repeatedly in wartime, the 'national research system' in name only; and later presidencies saw administration encroaching on scholarship. History shows the organic law and the peer council are two lines of defense; lose one and academic independence is a declaration only.
modern_applications_zh: 企业研究院设立：识别与产品线不同的'长周期研究'功能，单独立院、独立职级与研究预算，不与产品部门共用考核
基础研究职业轨道：为研究员设与管理者平行的晋升阶梯与同行评审，防止'做研究不如做管理'的逆向淘汰
开放科学接口：内部研究强制部分成果以英文/开源形式发表并参加国际会议——建制的可信度来自外部可检验性
智库立法先行：新设研究机构先争法定预算与治理章程，再扩编——避免'领导换人机构散伙'
modern_applications_en: Founding a corporate research institute: identify the long-horizon research function distinct from product lines; charter it separately with its own ranks and budget, never sharing assessment with product units.
A research career track: parallel promotion ladders for researchers and managers plus peer review, preventing the adverse selection of 'research pays worse than management.'

Open-science interfaces: require part of internal research to be published in English/open access and presented at international venues — an establishment's credibility comes from external checkability.
Legislate think tanks first: new research bodies secure statutory budgets and governance charters before headcount growth — to avoid 'the leader changes, the institute dissolves.'

傅斯年（史语所建制执行者）

modes.key_quote_zh: 中央研究院为中华民国最高学术研究机关……谋研究之自由，谋学术之独立，与夫分担在国家建设上之任务。
modes.key_quote_en: Academia Sinica is the Republic's highest institution of scholarly research... to secure freedom of research, to secure the independence of scholarship, and to bear its share of the tasks of national construction.

modes.name_en: The Principled Exit: Resignation as Veto
modes.domain_zh: 政治伦理/知识人行动策略
modes.domain_en: Political Ethics / The Intellectual's Action Repertoire
modes.definition_zh: 蔡元培一生七次辞职出走，把'退出'做成知识人最后的否决权：1919年五四运动中为营救被捕学生、抗议政府镇压，发表'杀君马者道旁儿'启事（'我倦矣！杀君马者道旁儿。'）不辞而别——用'我不再供职'表达对'我的供职正被用于镇压'的拒绝。方法论签名有三：其一，权位即杠杆的清醒——辞职的力量来自此前权位的积累，退出的时机选择在'去留能被解读'的当口，而非意气用事；其二，退而不散——每次出走都不解散其建制的成果（北大章程、中研院、大学院皆存续），退出是个人权位的终止而非制度的终止，'制度先于在位者'由退出行为本身示范；其三，退出即声明——每次辞职附公开缘由（病、倦、抗议），把私人决定变成公共文本，使退出成为可被引用的政治符号。这一模式为'体制内改革者'提供了完整的行动语法：进以建制，退以守则——体制的正当性可以被体制内的人用脚投票。
modes.definition_en: Cai Yuanpei resigned and walked out seven times in his life, making 'exit' the intellectual's final veto: during the May Fourth Movement of 1919, to rescue arrested students and protest the government's repression, he published the notice 'He who kills your horse is the child at the roadside. I am weary.' — and left without ceremony, declaring with 'I no longer serve' that his service was being used for repression. Three signatures define the mode. First, clarity that office is leverage: the force of resignation comes from the accumulated weight of the office; exit is timed for the moment when staying or leaving is legible, not in a fit of pique. Second, exit without demolition: each departure left his institutional achievements standing (the PKU charters, Academia Sinica, the University Council system all survived) — exit ended the person's tenure, never the institution; 'the institution outlives the officeholder' was demonstrated by the act itself. Third, exit as declaration: every resignation carried a public reason (illness, weariness, protest), turning a private decision into a public text and making the exit a quotable political symbol. The mode gives the reformer-inside-the-system a complete grammar of action: enter to build, exit to uphold — a system's legitimacy can be voted with one's feet by those inside it.
modes.source_chapter: 蔡元培五四辞职启事'杀君马者道旁儿'（1919年5月）；《蔡元培自写年谱》辞职记录；历次辞呈文本（教育总长、北大校长、大学院长任内）
process_zh: 预置退出条款：接受任何权位时先想清楚'何种情形下我必须离开'——退出条件在入职时即写成自己的红线清单，而非临场决定
积累可让渡的建制：在任期间把个人权威持续转存为制度（章程、委员会、继任规则），使自己的离开不带走成果——退出的资格正是'制度已能离开我'
选可读的时机：退出须发生在'去留能被公众解读'的当口（事件高峰、议题未散），提前或拖延都会让退出失去符号价值
附公开声明：辞职附具名缘由文本，把私人决定变成可引用的公共档案——无声退出只是缺席，有声明退出才是表态
process_en: Pre-install exit clauses: before accepting any office, decide in advance 'under what conditions I must leave' — write your red lines as a list at onboarding, not decided in the heat of the moment.

Convert authority into institutions while in office: continuously transfer personal authority into charters, committees, and succession rules so that leaving takes nothing with it — the qualification to exit is that the institution can already survive you.
Choose a legible moment: exit where staying-or-going can be publicly interpreted (at the peak of an event, while the issue is live); exiting too early or too late forfeits its symbolic value.
Attach a public statement: resign with a signed statement of reasons, turning a private decision into a citable public record — a silent exit is merely absence; a declared exit is a stand.
representative_cases_zh: 五四辞职（1919年5月9日）：学生被捕后蔡以'杀君马者道旁儿'启事出走——他判断自己的校长身份已成为政府'怀柔'人质，留在职位上反而使营救失去杠杆；出走后各地声援、学生获释，'退出'完成了'在位'无法完成的表达
多次辞总长与大学院长：凡教育部令与教育独立原则冲突（如要求师生签署效忠、政党势力侵入课程），蔡即辞职——用反复退出把'教育独立'立成历届政府不得不计算的约束
反面警示：退出策略的滥用与失效——频繁以辞职相要挟会使'退出'贬值（威胁不再被相信），而毫无声明的悄然离职只留下权力真空；蔡的每次出走都是'积累过建制之后的退出'：无建制者的退出是弃坑，有建制者的退出是交棒并设限——退出权的价值以此前建制的厚度计价
representative_cases_en: The May Fourth resignation, May 9, 1919: after students were arrested, Cai left with the notice 'He who kills your horse is the child at the roadside' — judging that his presidency had become a hostage of the government's appeasement play, and that staying would drain the leverage needed for rescue; after he walked, solidarity mounted and students were released: 'exit' accomplished what 'office' could not say.

Repeated ministerial exits: whenever a ministry order collided with educational independence (oaths of loyalty demanded of staff, party intrusion into curriculum), Cai resigned — using repeated exits to make 'educational independence' a constraint every subsequent government had to price in.

Cautionary counterexample: the misuse and decay of exit — serial resignation threats devalue exit (nobody believes the next one), and a silent departure leaves only a power vacuum. Every one of Cai's exits came after institutions had been built: the exit of one who has built nothing is abandonment; the exit of one who has built is a handover with conditions attached — the value of the exit right is priced by the thickness of the institutions built beforehand.
modern_applications_zh: 高管'红线离职'条款：入职时把不可妥协事项（数据造假、歧视纵容）写进自己的公开原则，触发即辞——把退出从情绪决定变成可预期承诺
公共知识人的退出声明：从被收编平台退出时附具名声明，使退出发声而非沉默消失
渐进式交棒设计：创始人把退出权用'继任规则+章程'预先定价，避免'人走茶凉'与'垂帘听政'两个失败态
项目治理中的否决退出：专业人员在项目违背职业伦理时保留公开退出的权利与声明的模板——专业判断的最后防线
modern_applications_en: Executives' red-line resignation clauses: write non-negotiables (data fabrication, tolerated discrimination) into one's public principles at onboarding; when triggered, resign — exit as predictable commitment, not emotional improvisation.
Public exit statements: when leaving a co-opted platform, publish a signed statement — exit as speech, not silent disappearance.

Succession-priced exits: founders pre-price their exit right with succession rules and charters, avoiding both the failed states of 'the tea cools when the person leaves' and 'rule from behind the curtain.'
Veto-by-exit in project governance: professionals retain the right and a template for public exit when a project violates professional ethics — the last line of defense of professional judgment.
